# S/MIME test vectors

Restored from `UCS-Care-Group/mailcraft` commit
`240d1d42fe394cf3274402b180663ba9b43ca180`, `crates/smime/testdata`.
The source test suite identifies these as RFC 9216 example certificates and
OpenSSL-generated message vectors. These are public examples, not user mail or keys.
